claim_under_attack.claim_text: Every interval this module publishes is computed by a method valid at its own n. role-parsimony-conformal-v1's bootstrap CIs at k=n=24 are [1.0,1.0] (deterministic_rule_baseline.in_domain_accuracy) and [1.0,1.0] (fitted_model_out_of_sample.loocv_accuracy) and [0.0,0.0] (noninferiority_test.accuracy_gap).
claim_under_attack.observed: Exact Clopper-Pearson lower bound at k=n=24 is 0.8575264022774743, not 1.0. The refutation criterion is MET: the published interval understates the true 95% uncertainty by 0.1425 (matches the campaign item's pre-registered figure of 0.142 within rounding).
claim_under_attack.refutation_criterion: A refutation occurs if the exact Clopper-Pearson two-sided 95% CI for the k=n=24 accuracy proportion differs from the published bootstrap CI [1.0,1.0] -- i.e. if the exact lower bound is < 1.0.

corrections.new_method: MOVER (Newcombe 1998b) paired-difference CI, phi=0 conservative, built from each margin's own Clopper-Pearson exact CI

external_rights (fixture is self-authored CC0; not an external benchmark)
objective: W-ROLE-CI: the role-parsimony-conformal-v1 replay receipt publishes three percentile-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals that collapse to a single point ([1.0,1.0] x2, [0.0,0.0] x1) because the underlying sample is k=n=24 (all predictions correct), so every one of the B=10000 bootstrap resamples is also all-correct and the empirical resample spread is zero. This mechanically understates sampling uncertainty: the true generalization accuracy is NOT known to be exactly 1.0 at n=24. Recompute each with a named exact method valid at the boundary and publish a superseding KPI; then sweep the portfolio for the same defect class and file every hit found.

phase0_gap_ledger.MANIFEST_UNCHANGED: master receipts manifest (66 receipts / 11 modules) NOT edited; requires human dual-identity Phase-0 ceremony keys.
phase0_gap_ledger.SCOPE: corrects interval ADMISSIBILITY only; does not change any point estimate, does not re-run the underlying classification, does not alter the noninferiority verdict (HYPOTHESIS_CORROBORATED_PARSIMONY_FAVOURED still stands on point estimates -- only its uncertainty band was wrong).
phase0_gap_ledger.SWEEP_SCOPE: 7170 of 7176 .json files under mvp20-split parsed (6 parse errors, mostly non-UTF8 or non-JSON-despite-extension files); only keys matching /ci|interval|bound|coverage/i were inspected for degenerate 2-element [0.0,0.0]/[1.0,1.0] arrays -- a differently-named degenerate interval field would not be caught.

primary_references: Clopper CJ, Pearson ES (1934). The use of confidence or fiducial limits illustrated in the case of the binomial. Biometrika 26(4):404-413.
Efron B, Tibshirani RJ (1993). An Introduction to the Bootstrap. Chapman & Hall/CRC, ISBN 978-0412042317, ch.13 (percentile bootstrap breakdown at parameter-space boundaries).
DiCiccio TJ, Efron B (1996). Bootstrap confidence intervals. Statistical Science 11(3):189-228.
Newcombe RG (1998). Improved confidence intervals for the difference between binomial proportions based on paired data. Statistics in Medicine 17(22):2635-2650 (MOVER / Method 10).

reproducibility.determinism_basis: All computation is closed-form (incomplete-beta inversion via scipy.stats.beta.ppf) or a deterministic full filesystem walk; no random sampling, no wall-clock, no OS entropy.

signing_key.used_for: AUDIT_ONLY W-ROLE-CI superseding KPI under evidence/phase0/repairs/W-ROLE-CI/done/

supersedes.reason: The target's three bootstrap 95% CIs are inadmissible at the k=n=24 / k1=k2=n1=n2=24 boundary (percentile bootstrap has zero resample variance there). This superseding KPI republishes the same headline point estimates (accuracy 1.0 vs 1.0, gap 0.0) with exact-at-boundary intervals: Clopper-Pearson for the two accuracy margins, MOVER (Newcombe 1998b, phi=0 conservative) for the paired gap. The original file is left byte-intact; this is a NEW artifact, not an edit.

sweep.method: walked every .json file under mvp20-split (excluding .git/target/node_modules/__pycache__), parsed each, and for every 2-element numeric array reachable under a key matching /ci|interval|bound|coverage/i, flagged it if both elements == 0.0 or both == 1.0
